business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Healthcare staffing and total talent solutions, including workforce technology, strategic consulting, and healthcare interpreting.

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Direct staffing and placement, fully managed workforce programs, self-service workforce technology, strategic consulting, and interpreter services.

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Billable clinician hours for travel staffing, search and placement fees for permanent recruiting, and per-minute billing for interpreting.

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Repeat contingent staffing through managed workforce programs that can expand across client service lines and facilities.

implementation_transition_work.label: Implementation / transition work
implementation_transition_work.value: Labor model redesign with client leadership and workforce program expansion across service lines, facilities, and regions.

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: WorkWise covers healthcare workforce planning, staffing and vendor management, scheduling, and analytics for internal and external labor.

staffing_placement_model_736.label: Staffing / placement model [736]
staffing_placement_model_736.value: Travel, contract, per diem, temp-to-hire, and permanent placements for clinical and nonclinical healthcare professionals.

notes: WorkWise’s hosting and subscription model are unclear.
